verdict.rationale: Airbyte has no dedicated sandbox or test-mode feature. The evidence only implies workarounds: a disposable local Airbyte Core instance via the OSS quickstart and abctl, separate workspaces on paid plans, Connector Builder development inside a workspace, and PyAirbyte local caches pitched for early prototyping and notebooks. Each of these keeps testing apart from production, but none is a first-class sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/staging environment feature, mock or sample-data test sources, explicit guidance on isolating test runs from production destinations, and independent corroboration of safe testing workflows.
